name: Hagrid's Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure
description: The greatest and most beloved theme park attraction of the 21st century — Hagrid's Magical Creatures Motorbike Adventure is a jaw-dropping outdoor roller coaster through the Forbidden Forest featuring stunning magical creatures, extraordinary themed environments, multiple surprise elements including a backwards launch into a Devil's Snare pit, a free-fall drop and Hagrid himself on his motorbike sidecar. Universally regarded as the finest theme park attraction in the world. Min 122cm.

name: Jurassic World VelociCoaster
description: The most thrilling and technically accomplished roller coaster at any theme park in Florida — Jurassic World VelociCoaster is a breathtaking launched coaster reaching 113 km/h with 12 seconds of airtime, a 150-degree banked turn, an iconic 17-metre top hat inversion over the lagoon and one of the most intense and rerideable coaster experiences in the world. Min 122cm.

name: Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts
description: The centrepiece attraction of the Wizarding World of Harry Potter — Diagon Alley at Universal Studios Florida — Harry Potter and the Escape from Gringotts is a spectacular multi-dimensional ride through Gringotts Bank combining roller coaster elements with 3D screens, fire effects, water effects and appearances by Harry, Ron, Hermione, Voldemort and the Hungarian Horntail dragon. Min 102cm.

name: Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit
description: A spectacular and unique musical roller coaster soaring above Universal Studios Florida — Hollywood Rip Ride Rockit allows riders to choose their own soundtrack from dozens of songs before launching into a 65-metre vertical lift and a thrilling layout of high-speed turns and the unique non-inversion loop above CityWalk. Min 122cm.

name: Revenge of the Mummy
description: A legendary and iconic indoor roller coaster and dark ride hybrid — Revenge of the Mummy is a classic Universal Studios attraction featuring a thrilling backwards launch in darkness, fire effects, psychological scares and one of the most beloved and rerideable indoor coaster experiences at any theme park in the world. A Universal icon since 1996. Min 122cm.

name: Men in Black: Alien Attack
description: A beloved and entertaining interactive dark ride at Universal Studios Florida — Men in Black: Alien Attack is a classic shooting dark ride where guests compete to score points by blasting aliens alongside Will Smith in a thrilling alien invasion scenario. One of the most fun and rerideable attractions at Universal. Min 107cm.

name: Fast & Furious: Supercharged
description: A high-octane tram ride experience at Universal Studios Florida placing guests inside the world of Fast & Furious with a spectacular 360-degree screen experience, racing sequences and appearances by the film franchise cast. One of the most immersive screen-based experiences at Universal. Min 102cm.

name: Wizarding World of Harry Potter — Diagon Alley
description: The most immersive and extraordinary themed land at any theme park in the world — Diagon Alley at Universal Studios Florida is a breathtaking recreation of the hidden magical street from the Harry Potter series featuring Gringotts Bank, Ollivanders wand shop, Weasleys Wizard Wheezes, the Leaky Cauldron pub and the Hogwarts Express connection to Hogsmeade at Islands of Adventure. Suitable for all ages.

name: Hogwarts Express
description: The most unique and magical inter-park experience at any theme park resort — Hogwarts Express connects Diagon Alley at Universal Studios Florida to Hogsmeade at Islands of Adventure via a spectacular train journey featuring different window scenes and in-carriage experiences in each direction. Requires admission to both parks. Suitable for all ages.

name: Cabana Bay Beach Resort
description: The most beloved and celebrated on-site hotel at Universal Orlando — Cabana Bay Beach Resort is a spectacular retro 1950s-60s themed resort featuring two stunning pool complexes including a lazy river, a bowling alley, outstanding dining and the best value accommodation at Universal Orlando Resort.

name: Transformers: The Ride-3D
description: A spectacular and immersive 3D dark ride at Universal Studios Florida placing guests inside the Transformers universe alongside Optimus Prime and Bumblebee in an extraordinary battle against the Decepticons across New York City. One of the most technically advanced screen-based ride experiences at any theme park. Min 102cm.
